verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (kong-docs-9) and Dev Portal explicitly lets users/agents publish and download API specs in OpenAPI or AsyncAPI format (kong-docs-47), directly satisfying the machine-readable spec download story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of downloading these specs, and the probe found no top-level openapi.json at the docs root (kong-probe-2), suggesting the spec directory isn't a single well-known static file.
